subject: 🏃 Friday AM Update — Modified Friday + Saturday (Wk 2, pre-B2B)
html:
Plan modified this morning. Three real stimulus days back-to-back (Tue 6×800m VO2 → Wed heavy squat → Thu progression with 19:30 in Z4) plus tight legs is enough signal to deload the next 48 hr into Bay to Breakers. Friday gets bodyweight-only, Saturday becomes a walk instead of a shakeout jog. Sunday B2B stays as scripted.

Today (Fri) — Bodyweight Stability + PT block, ~30 min. No loaded Bulgarian splits, no DB single-leg RDLs this week. Pre-race weeks aren't where you chase strength PRs; you protect what you already built.

ExerciseDose
Foam roll quads / IT band1 min each leg
90/90 PAILs30 sec each side
Banded lateral walks10 each direction
Spanish squat hold (BW)3 × 30–45 sec
Copenhagen plank (BW)3 × 30 sec each side
Side plank w/ hip abd (PT)8 reps each, top toe pointing to floor
Dead bug w/ banded pulldown (PT)2–3 × 10 slow marches
Chin tuck + lifts (PT)2 reps each direction, 3-sec hold

PT follow-up today with Akanksha. This is the bigger event. Be upfront about the full picture: V6 is running you at 6–8 mi including threshold work, heavy squatting 155 lb, and the knee has been 1/5 across every session — including yesterday's 19:30 in Z4. Whatever new restrictions or progressions she sets override the plan.

Tomorrow (Sat) — 45–60 min walk, not a jog. Brisk (15–17 min/mi), no hills. Walking gives you the blood flow and mobility a shakeout would, with zero eccentric loading on the knee and zero junk fatigue going into Sunday. Pre-check all 3 Maurten gels Saturday night — one-handed dry-tear test on each pouch, set aside any that don't open clean.

Focus cue: today is about protection, not stimulus. If anything feels grindy, stop early. Sunday is the workout that matters this week.

Context: Week 2 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — 10 weeks to race day. Bay to Breakers 15K Sunday: 10 mi total, miles 1–6 @ 8:30–8:45 steady, miles 6–9.3 @ 7:35–7:45 MP (cap at 7:35, do not let race-day adrenaline pull this to 7:10). Hayes Hill by effort.
